# Contributing to Hadron

Thank you for investing your time in contributing to Hadron!

## Getting Started

1. Ensure Python 3.11+ and Node.js 20+ are installed.
2. Read `docs/setup.md` and `docs/architecture.md` for project context.
3. Review `docs/deployment.md` for runtime environment and deployment rules.

## Pull Request Guidelines

- All PRs must adhere to the monorepo structure.
- Follow conventional commits (`feat:`, `fix:`, `docs:`, etc.).
- Ensure all CI/CD workflows in GitHub Actions pass completely.
